definitions: A girl or woman who has one or both of the same parents as another person.
A female fellow member of a religious order, especially a nun.
A senior nurse, typically in charge of a ward or department in a hospital.
A female friend or associate, especially used as a term of address among women.
A member of a women's organization, such as a sorority.
examples: Sister Mary is a kind woman.
The ward sister will see you now.
All the sisters gathered for the meeting.
